title: Lawn Restoration Payment Computation for Exterior Lines, Utility Line Protection Plans
content:
# Lawn Restoration Payment Computation

Claims Finance computation note for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans, exterior lines.

## The calculation

The lawn restoration payment is figured once per service request, on the day it is booked and from the plan's records as they stand that day; periods said to run to the request date end on the service request's request date. The lawn restoration figure is the plan's landscaping restoration allowance as a flat amount, whatever the landscaper charges. The lawn restoration payment is never more than the occurrence benefit still open, which is the plan's occurrence cap for the line (the water line occurrence cap for a water service line, the sewer line occurrence cap for a sewer lateral or a septic line, the electrical line occurrence cap for an electrical service line, the gas line occurrence cap for a gas service line) less every amount already authorized, net of reversals, on the service request and on the earlier request whose occurrence it belongs to: for a recall reported no later than the plan's repair guarantee days after the most recent completed repair on the same line, the request of that completed repair, and for a new failure reported no more than the lawn continuation days (14 days) after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same line, that temporary-repair request. The lawn restoration payment is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Input sheet

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| Landscaping restoration allowance | a figure of the plan held |
| Occurrence cap for the line | water line cap for the exterior water service line; sewer line cap for the sewer lateral or septic line; electrical line cap for the exterior electrical service line; gas line cap for the exterior gas service line (figures of the plan held) |
| Repair guarantee days | a figure of the plan held |
| Lawn continuation days | 14 calendar days |
| Net amounts authorized | claim history: authorizations less reversals, per service request |

## Input, judgement, output

- **Input:** the service request (type, line, request date), its net amounts, and any linked earlier request.
- **Judgement:** a recall within the repair guarantee days of the most recent completed repair on the same line is joined to that repair's request; a new failure within 14 days of a temporary repair authorized on another request for the line is joined to that request; any other request stands alone.
- **Output:** the lower of the lawn restoration figure and the open benefit, rounded to the cent.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures, not plan values)

Assume a landscaping restoration allowance of $300.00 and a sewer line occurrence cap of $9000.00.

1. Sewer lateral request with $4000.00 net authorized and no linked request: open benefit $5000.00; payment $300.00.
2. Sewer lateral recall within the guarantee, $6000.00 net on the completed repair's request and $2850.00 on the recall: open benefit $150.00; payment $150.00.
